prose: Gabriel, AKA Slick Dissident, returns to InnerVerse to explore his innovative Tarot-tories system, in which he has mapped the wheel of the zodiac and its archetypal symbolism to the geographical regions of the United States. In the first hour we discuss the value of this sort of symbolic study, and the basic layout of his cipher.
ext: We go on a two hour whirlwind tour of the 22 Major Arcana cards as they show up in corresponding areas on the US map, building on the concepts introduced in the first segment of the show.
